lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns and five horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region and superior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a regular geometric grid pattern across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct linear features running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a high-luminance superior edge and a low-luminance inferior shadow, indicating raised anatomical ridges.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a distinct secondary marine organism (remora) attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
